objective: Ejecutar el backfill REAL y definitivo de pagos ISCAM ManagementPro para 130QRO, agosto 2026, usando el fix R9 ya integrado. Poblar exclusivamente dbo.Finanzas_CortesCaja_DetallePagos y certificar con SQL de solo lectura.

queries.name: 130qro_pagos_agosto_post_backfill
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS filas, COUNT(DISTINCT NumeroTicket) AS tickets, CAST(ISNULL(SUM(Importe),0) AS decimal(18,2)) AS importe, CAST(ISNULL(SUM(Propina),0) AS decimal(18,2)) AS propina, MIN(FechaHora) AS fecha_min, MAX(FechaHora) AS fecha_max FROM dbo.Finanzas_CortesCaja_DetallePagos WHERE UnidadNegocio='130QRO' AND FechaHora >= '2026-08-01' AND FechaHora < '2026-09-01' AND ISNULL(Activo,1)=1

queries.name: 130qro_pagos_por_forma_agosto
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (20) ISNULL(FormaPago,'SIN_FORMA') AS forma_pago, ISNULL(FormaPagoCodigo,'') AS codigo, COUNT(*) AS filas, CAST(SUM(Importe) AS decimal(18,2)) AS importe, CAST(SUM(Propina) AS decimal(18,2)) AS propina FROM dbo.Finanzas_CortesCaja_DetallePagos WHERE UnidadNegocio='130QRO' AND FechaHora >= '2026-08-01' AND FechaHora < '2026-09-01' AND ISNULL(Activo,1)=1 GROUP BY FormaPago,FormaPagoCodigo ORDER BY importe DESC
